competing_explanation: The policy may use a different return window, distinguish standard from special items, or measure the 30-day period from purchase rather than delivery, making the stated 30-day full-refund window inaccurate.
hypothesis_statement: H_J: The correct CURRENT 30-day full-refund return window for standard items is 30 days, allowing a full refund if the item is returned within 30 days under the current policy.
refutation_criterion: Refuted if the current policy specifies a different full-refund window for standard items, defines the window from a different trigger date without preserving a 30-day full-refund period, or excludes standard items from the 30-day full-refund policy.
